group_unit: original independent physical sample or subject; archive row IDs are not evidence of independence

official_test.parameter_selection: fixed stratified grouped holdout within official training data
official_test.reason_for_fixed_validation: Keep v1 affordable and consistent with the current single-run Agent; three-way repeated validation is reserved for a predefined stability subset
official_test.group_overlap_policy: Use a documented corrected grouped protocol or exclude from the independent primary pool; never silently retain subject leakage

without_official_test.test_partition_strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold for grouped measurements; StratifiedKFold only for justified independent rows
without_official_test.fallback: Try fixed-seed 3-fold only when all 5-fold partitions cannot retain every class in Train, Valid and Test; otherwise exclude from the primary pool with a recorded reason

selection_boundary.normalization_and_feature_transforms: fit only on the applicable training subset

model_eligibility.unordered_tabular_features: do not assume that a synthetic feature index is a physically ordered spectral or time axis

primary_comparisons.R0: uniform random eligible model with one fixed default candidate
primary_comparisons.A0: LLM selects eligible model with the same one fixed default candidate
primary_comparisons.R1: uniform random eligible model with the same frozen up-to-three configurations as A1
primary_comparisons.A1: LLM selects eligible model with the same frozen up-to-three configurations as R1
primary_comparisons.fixed_model: chosen only from the development pool and frozen before primary evaluation
primary_comparisons.portfolio_default_and_hpo: select by Valid; separately report the full multi-model cost
primary_comparisons.test_oracle: descriptive upper reference only, never a deployable baseline

primary_agent_modules.knowledge: off for the first model-selection attribution comparison; static knowledge receives a separately named ablation
primary_agent_modules.budget_awareness: off; hard execution limits and fail-fast guard stay on
primary_agent_modules.LLM_hyperparameter_choice: A0/A1 first isolate model choice with common model defaults and HPO; direct LM parameter proposals require a separately named equal-budget comparison
primary_agent_modules.normal_LM_calls: selection plus finalization; repairs and network retries are additionally measured

hpo.objective: Valid balanced accuracy for all compared candidate-search methods
hpo.deep_checkpoint_selection: existing lowest Valid loss within each candidate; candidate comparison uses the balanced accuracy of that checkpoint
hpo.random_forest_oob: auxiliary audit only for the shared-objective comparison; current OOB-driven search may be reported as a separately named native baseline
hpo.final_training: retain the same model-specific trainer for every method: classical Train+Valid refit; current deep best-Valid-loss checkpoint without additional refit
hpo.table_resolution: Use existing frozen defaults for other parameters, put the default first, filter dimension-invalid choices before LM selection; record fewer than three when only fewer distinct legal choices remain. Never silently use the old enumeration prefix.
deferred_comparisons: random_search versus optuna_tpe versus native enumeration
hpo.budget_unit: distinct hyperparameter configurations for one selected model in one task evaluation round; candidate training and final combined-data training are separately counted

predictions_and_aggregation.within_task_evaluation: pooled predictions collected while each sample is held out for testing for primary metrics; fold mean/std are audit fields
predictions_and_aggregation.repeated_measurement_aggregation: mean class probabilities within each sample, fixed before evaluation
predictions_and_aggregation.random_baseline: reuse the hidden per-model result matrix on identical evaluation rounds; recompute pooled metrics for cached random selections
predictions_and_aggregation.across_tasks: equal-weight task summaries within suites, plus family-aware summaries when tasks share original samples
predictions_and_aggregation.statistical_unit: independent task family, never individual evaluation rounds
predictions_and_aggregation.incomplete_rounds: Do not calculate a complete task score from only successful evaluation rounds; report the task as incomplete, failure coverage and the common-complete subset explicitly
predictions_and_aggregation.inference: family-level paired bootstrap intervals and, where appropriate, paired Wilcoxon tests with Holm multiple-comparison correction
predictions_and_aggregation.primary_summary: equal-weight mean task balanced_accuracy on complete locked tasks, with suite/family breakdown and explicit all-planned coverage

development_and_locking.stability_subset: 20-30 tasks selected by metadata before observing method scores

logging.no_LM: explicit zero requests and zero tokens
logging.cache_costs: record actual executed cost separately from the uncached method cost
logging.parent_child_spans: retain hierarchy; never sum overlapping durations

scope_limit: Approved first-round fixed-processing comparisons; dynamic processing has two functional checks only. Memory, feedback actions, external agents and extra seeds are outside this execution.

governance.rule: Initial protocol requires explicit user approval; after approval, any scientific protocol change requires separate explicit user authorization and a retained version/change record.
governance.approval_basis: Historical protocol used only as an offline test fixture; this file does not authorize experiments.

weights.representative_rule: first successful default model in fixed development-task order; never choose by Test
